{{Quote|Star Tours, this is a restricted area! What are you doing here? Stay clear of the combat zone!|Snowspeeder pilot|<ref name="ST2" />}}
This '''snowspeeder pilot''' was a member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. During a battle with [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|walkers]], the pilot warned a [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency [[StarSpeeder 1000|vessel]] to stay clear of the area when the ship accidentally flew directly into the combat zone.<ref name="ST2" />

==Behind the scenes==
Since the [[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue|''Star Tours'']] attraction visits one of three different planets during each segment of the ride, this snowspeeder pilot does not always appear.<ref name="ST2" /> The pilot's dialogue is very similar to lines spoken by the original [[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']] ride's [[Red Leader (Star Tours)|Red Leader]]. The snowspeeder pilot is portrayed by [[Rob Howe]], a member of the fan group [[Rebel Legion]].<ref name="501st Star Tours">{{SW|url=news/how-the-501st-and-rebel-legions-became-part-of-star-tours|text=How the 501st and Rebel Legions Became Part of Star Tours}}</ref>
